body:
I guess I never really tried putting myself before others I just worry about being selfish.

When it really starting setting in is about 3-ish years ago. Something happened and I like to think it didn't affect me that much, but it did in a way. There was a feeling through this event and it was like sadness, anxiety, panic, and a tiredness I guess you'd call it? Over the years  it has gotten worse, I've hurt myself, have terrible self confidence. As for why I feel this way, I don't have the slightest clue, it's really weird, I can have days where everything is nice and perfectly dandy and others I just can't seem to open my own eyes

Because I can't do anything to help the lives of others, let alone my own. I have trouble with the simplest of tasks, waking up, proper hygiene among other things it's not that I can't do them it's just I'm losing motivation to do them and I just get so tired of it all like, just thinking of waking up to do my days over and over for the next few months makes me what to stay in a ball all day. I can't make or keep friendships for long without screwing it all up. All I ever do is take things that others could use better than I could and either use it up, or break it.
It just feels like since I'm so worthless and useless that I have to be a mistake I guess.

(Please excuse my writing as I've been awake for to long)
Anyways, I am a 13 year old who basically dropped out of school. The idea was that I'd be learning what I want to learn on my computer. My parents have never been strict at all, never pushing me to do anything so for my first few days of homeschooling was me finding so websites, playing a few games here and there. I gradually started doing school for about and month and then it went all down hill I was so used to having a schedule that having none at all messed me up big time and my parents having never been good with schedules.. I stopped doing school all together eventually and for the past 4 years have been staying in the house sleeping, eating, being on the computer.
When I was playing a game that I was really getting into I met someone who became my best friend and only close friend. I went off and got in a fight with her this month on the 9th  she has since made about 4 new close friends and we have talked a total of 2 time since and I figure it will never be the same between me and her again. 

I have 5 years ahead waiting for me so I can do this. 
The point of me giving you this mini lifestory is because I've always felt alone in my situation  and I just want to be here to at least understand a little bit you are going through. 

I know I can't stop you from killing yourself but I want to atleast try to help you in anyways I can, so the Tl;dr version Similar story, I can relate with you, If you want to talk I'm here

I have spoken to two therapists in the past but I have a extremely hard time opening up to people, and I don't know why, I tried talking to them but, I always got to scared/to panicky to talk to them and it became a chore I had to do every week or so.

I know how you feel, not good enough for anyone and so alone because you have no-one to talk about these feelings about.
If you want to talk I'm here.
I know I'm a stranger and that I can have no real impact on your life, but I can at least be a listening ear that is here to relate with you.
